title: Night Beat
paragraphs: Frank Lovejoy stars as Randy Stone, a Chicago Star reporter who walks the city after dark, following stories that move between crime, mystery, and the private lives of people he meets on his night beat.

36-recording GRH preservation subset of the larger NBC run starring Frank Lovejoy as Chicago Star night reporter Randy Stone. The collection is not complete. Episode chronology, sponsor provenance, AFRS forms and filename/tag contamination are represented additively.
GRH documents the program through NBC Night Beat run (February 6, 1950 to September 25, 1952) on [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]].

Among the most extensively documented contributors in the GRH holdings are [[person|frank-lovejoy|Frank Lovejoy]] (performer on 36 recordings), Warren Lewis (director on 35 recordings, producer on 23 recordings, writer on 3 recordings, and editor on 1 recording), Frank Worth (music on 11 recordings, composer on 8 recordings, and conductor on 8 recordings), Robert Armbruster (music on 14 recordings and conductor on 3 recordings), Larry Marcus (writer on 11 recordings and editor on 4 recordings), Joan Banks (performer on 9 recordings), and [[person|william-conrad|William Conrad]] (performer on 9 recordings).
The program is also connected in the archive to [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]] (broadcast on network) and [[org|org.99a83c858631bdcc|WNBC]] (aircheck from station).

Its indexed subjects and listening characteristics include newspaper reporting and journalism, human-interest stories and private lives, urban night life and city streets, crime and criminal investigation, gambling and rackets, and aviation and aircraft danger.
GRH also places the series in documented historical contexts including Postwar urban newspaper drama, NBC sustaining and sponsored dramatic programming, and AFRS preservation and rediscovery.

Programs with especially strong personnel connections in the GRH knowledge graph include [[show|lux-radio-theatre|Lux Radio Theatre]] (67 shared credited people), [[show|escape|Escape]] (68 shared credited people), [[show|yours-truly-johnny-dollar|Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar]] (63 shared credited people), [[show|screen-directors-playhouse|Screen Directors Playhouse]] (65 shared credited people), and [[show|the-whistler|The Whistler]] (62 shared credited people).
